# McGovern Medical School

> > McGovern Medical School at UTHealth Houston is a comprehensive academic medical institution offering MD, graduate medical education, and specialized health professions programs with a focus on physician training, research, and professional development.

McGovern Medical School serves as the educational and research hub for the University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston, providing undergraduate medical education, graduate medical education through ACGME-accredited residency programs, and specialized master's programs in anesthesia and cardiovascular perfusion. The school emphasizes curriculum management, faculty resources, and student support services across all levels of medical training.

## Admissions & Student Services

- [Office of Admissions and Student Affairs](https://med.uth.edu/admissions): Admissions and student affairs office for prospective medical students
- [Pre-Entry Program](https://med.uth.edu/oep/medical-education/student-programs/pre-entry-program): Summer preparation program for incoming medical students
- [About Us](https://med.uth.edu/about-us): McGovern Medical School mission, values, and institutional overview

## Undergraduate Medical Education

- [MD Program](https://med.uth.edu/oep/medical-education-2): MD program overview, curriculum, and clinical competency information
- [Office of Educational Programs](https://med.uth.edu/oep): Educational programs administration, curriculum, and physician training
- [Scholarly Concentration Program (SCP)](https://med.uth.edu/oep/msro/msro-programs/scp): Scholarly Concentration Program with mentorship and research projects

## Graduate Medical Education & Training Programs

- [Office of Graduate Medical Education](https://med.uth.edu/gme): Graduate medical education, residency, and fellowship training programs
- [Training Programs](https://med.uth.edu/gme/general-information/uth-programs): Directory of ACGME-accredited residency and specialty programs
- [Master of Science in Anesthesia Program](https://med.uth.edu/msa): Master of Science in Anesthesia graduate program and admissions
- [Cardiovascular Perfusion Program](https://med.uth.edu/perfusion): Cardiovascular Perfusion Program with accreditation and admissions info

## Faculty & Research Support

- [Office of Research Affairs](https://med.uth.edu/researchaffairs): Research affairs, faculty resources, and graduate education support
- [Office of Professionalism](https://med.uth.edu/professionalism): Professional development for medical students, residents, and faculty
- [Graduate Student Education Committee](https://med.uth.edu/gsec): Graduate student programs, career development, and research awards

## Student Support & Wellness

- [Wellness](https://med.uth.edu/wellness): Wellness programs, mental health support, and counseling services

## Administrative & Technology Services

- [Medical School Information Technology](https://med.uth.edu/msit): IT support, help desk, and technology resources for medical school
